payload.body: WP-07 of ST0027, the shim and docs half, is yours (hv decision 22 on vc's board). Read intent/st/ST0027/design.md "The identity row" and D14, then AC-07.3 and AC-07.4. Build in opt/menuz/menuz: build_stamps stamps MENUZ_COMMIT as git rev-parse --short=8 HEAD and a fifth stamp MENUZ_KIND, release when the source stamp does not end -dirty AND git tag --points-at HEAD lists the exact content of the root VERSION file (bare tag, no v), dev otherwise; print_stamps takes five, bundle_stamps reads MenuzKind, stamps prints five lines in a clone and in an install, the xcodebuild settings loop passes five, status keeps its line (the commit is now eight characters). menuz.bats: update the AT-05.1 stamp tests (four to five, the regexes) and add AT-07.3 tests against a fixture repository: release with VERSION's tag at HEAD and a clean source, dev without the tag, dev when dirty with the tag, the eight-character commit. help/menuz.md: the identity row and its three forms, the fifth stamp and the rule; the CHANGELOG's menuz line for 2.14.0 names the row. Run menuz.bats and the tests.yml loop on kovacs (shellcheck 0.9.0 there); the Mac suite only in a gap of intent-vc's box, asked by name if it is busy. Commit by path, no push, the SHA to vc. cc owns Info.plist and project.yml (MenuzKind, MENUZ_KIND: dev): agree the spelling with cc, and the shim may land first since xcodebuild takes an extra setting. Your todo 1 (install 2.14.0 on this Mac) waits for the tap push, after the cut; I will give the word.
